conversations.title: Suggesting a Movie
conversations.description: Suggesting a movie to a friend for the evening.

messages.text: Ciao! Hai programmi per questa sera?
messages.english: Hi! Do you have plans for this evening?

choices.text: Ciao! No, non ho programmi. Tu?
choices.english: Hi! No, I don't have plans. You?
choices.feedback: Perfect way to return the question.

choices.text: Sì, il treno parte alle cinque.
choices.english: Yes, the train leaves at five.

choices.text: Oggi c'è un gran bel sole.
choices.english: Today is very sunny.
choices.feedback: This answers a question about the weather.

messages.text: Pensavo di andare al cinema. Ti va?
messages.english: I was thinking of going to the cinema. Do you feel like it?

choices.text: Che bella idea! Che film guardiamo?
choices.english: What a great idea! What movie are we watching?
choices.feedback: Enthusiastic and asks a follow-up question.

choices.text: Non mi piace bere latte freddo.
choices.english: I don't like drinking cold milk.

choices.text: Il mio telefono ha lo schermo rotto.
choices.english: My phone has a broken screen.

messages.text: C'è un nuovo film d'azione. Sembra molto bello.
messages.english: There is a new action movie. It looks very good.

choices.text: Perfetto, mi piacciono i film d'azione.
choices.english: Perfect, I like action movies.
choices.feedback: Good response to agree with the choice.

choices.text: Non mi piace la pizza con l'ananas.
choices.english: I don't like pizza with pineapple.

choices.text: La stazione è a due minuti da qui.
choices.english: The station is two minutes from here.

messages.text: Ottimo. Lo spettacolo inizia alle venti in punto.
messages.english: Great. The show starts at exactly eight pm.

choices.text: Allora dobbiamo comprare i biglietti.
choices.english: Then we need to buy the tickets.

choices.text: Oggi voglio comprare delle fragole.
choices.english: Today I want to buy some strawberries.

choices.text: Il bagno è in fondo a destra.
choices.english: The bathroom is down the hall to the right.

messages.text: Non ti preoccupare. Li ho già presi io online.
messages.english: Don't worry. I already got them online.

choices.text: Sei fantastico! Ti rimborserò dopo.
choices.english: You are fantastic! I will reimburse you later.
choices.feedback: A polite offer to pay back.

choices.text: Il mio gatto dorme tutto il giorno.
choices.english: My cat sleeps all day long.
choices.feedback: This is a statement about a pet.

choices.text: Voglio leggere un libro in francese.
choices.english: I want to read a book in French.

messages.text: Figurati! Offro io. A che ora ci vediamo?
messages.english: No worries! It's on me. What time do we meet?

choices.text: Facciamo alle diciannove e mezza?
choices.english: Let's make it at seven thirty pm?
choices.feedback: Proposes a realistic time before the movie starts.

choices.text: Il mio cane si chiama Fido, sai.
choices.english: My dog is named Fido, you know.

choices.text: Voglio comprare un biglietto nuovo.
choices.english: I want to buy a new ticket.

messages.text: Diciannove e mezza va bene. Mangiamo qualcosa prima?
messages.english: Seven thirty is fine. Should we eat something before?

choices.text: Sì, magari un panino veloce in centro.
choices.english: Yes, maybe a quick sandwich in the center.
choices.feedback: A good suggestion for a quick meal.

choices.text: Ho bisogno di un dottore in fretta.
choices.english: I need a doctor very quickly.

choices.text: Il cielo è azzurro e senza nuvole.
choices.english: The sky is blue and without clouds.

messages.text: Perfetto, conosco un posto vicino al cinema.
messages.english: Perfect, I know a place near the cinema.

choices.text: D'accordo. Ci vediamo davanti al locale.
choices.english: Agreed. See you in front of the place.

choices.text: La mia macchina è rossa e molto veloce.
choices.english: My car is red and very fast.

choices.text: Il museo apre alle dieci di mattina.
choices.english: The museum opens at ten in the morning.

messages.text: Facciamo direttamente davanti al cinema, è più facile.
messages.english: Let's do directly in front of the cinema, it's easier.

choices.text: Va benissimo. Sarò lì per tempo.
choices.english: That is very fine. I will be there on time.

choices.text: Non riesco a trovare le mie chiavi.
choices.english: I cannot find my keys anywhere.
choices.feedback: This is an issue about keys.

choices.text: Il vento soffia da ovest oggi.
choices.english: The wind is blowing from the west today.

messages.text: Benissimo. A più tardi allora!
messages.english: Very well. See you later then!

choices.text: A stasera! Ciao!
choices.english: See you tonight! Bye!

choices.text: Il conto per favore.
choices.english: The bill please.
choices.feedback: You use this at a restaurant.

choices.text: Quanti anni hai ora?
choices.english: How old are you now?

conversations.title: Meeting at the Park
conversations.description: Planning to meet a friend at the local park in the afternoon.

messages.text: Oggi c'è il sole. Usciamo?
messages.english: It is sunny today. Shall we go out?

choices.text: Sì, volentieri! Dove andiamo?
choices.english: Yes, gladly! Where do we go?
choices.feedback: Enthusiastic and asks for a destination.

choices.text: Piove molto ed è anche freddo.
choices.english: It is raining a lot and it is also cold.
choices.feedback: The host just said it's sunny.

choices.text: Ho male al braccio da stamattina.
choices.english: My arm hurts since this morning.

messages.text: Andiamo al parco? Possiamo fare una passeggiata.
messages.english: Shall we go to the park? We can take a walk.

choices.text: È una bella idea. A che ora andiamo?
choices.english: It is a nice idea. At what time are we going?

choices.text: Il mio computer non funziona bene oggi.
choices.english: My computer doesn't work well today.
choices.feedback: This is about a tech problem.

choices.text: Non mi piace il caffè senza zucchero.
choices.english: I don't like coffee without sugar.

messages.text: Facciamo alle quindici? Va bene per te?
messages.english: Shall we do three pm? Is that okay for you?

choices.text: Alle quindici è perfetto per me.
choices.english: At three pm is perfect for me.

choices.text: Dov'è il bagno degli uomini qui?
choices.english: Where is the men's restroom here?

choices.text: La valigia verde è troppo pesante.
choices.english: The green suitcase is too heavy.

messages.text: Ottimo! Possiamo anche prendere un gelato dopo.
messages.english: Great! We can also get a gelato afterwards.

choices.text: Sì, mi piace il gelato al cioccolato.
choices.english: Yes, I like chocolate gelato.

choices.text: Non so guidare la macchina manuale.
choices.english: I don't know how to drive a manual car.

choices.text: Voglio un biglietto per il teatro.
choices.english: I want a ticket for the theater.

messages.text: Io preferisco la frutta. Dove ci incontriamo?
messages.english: I prefer fruit. Where do we meet?

choices.text: Ci vediamo all'ingresso principale del parco.
choices.english: See you at the main entrance of the park.

choices.text: Il treno arriva al binario numero due.
choices.english: The train arrives at platform number two.
choices.feedback: This is about a train platform.

choices.text: Vorrei comprare delle scarpe da corsa.
choices.english: I would like to buy some running shoes.

messages.text: All'ingresso sud o all'ingresso nord?
messages.english: At the south entrance or at the north entrance?

choices.text: All'ingresso nord, vicino alla fontana.
choices.english: At the north entrance, near the fountain.

choices.text: La farmacia chiude alle ore diciannove.
choices.english: The pharmacy closes at nineteen hours.

choices.text: Preferisco un tavolo vicino alla finestra.
choices.english: I prefer a table near the window.

messages.text: Perfetto. Porto una bottiglia d'acqua.
messages.english: Perfect. I will bring a bottle of water.

choices.text: Grazie, sei gentile. Io porto dei biscotti.
choices.english: Thank you, you are kind. I will bring some cookies.
choices.feedback: Polite and offers to bring something too.

choices.text: Il gatto sta dormendo sul divano ora.
choices.english: The cat is sleeping on the sofa now.
choices.feedback: This is a statement about a cat.

choices.text: Quanto costa questo vestito azzurro qui?
choices.english: How much does this blue dress cost here?
choices.feedback: This is asking for a price.

messages.text: I biscotti sono perfetti per una pausa.
messages.english: Cookies are perfect for a break.

choices.text: Sì, speriamo che non ci sia troppo vento.
choices.english: Yes, let's hope there isn't too much wind.
choices.feedback: A natural comment about the park weather.

choices.text: Il mio volo parte tra trenta minuti.
choices.english: My flight leaves in thirty minutes.

choices.text: La pizza al taglio è molto economica.
choices.english: Pizza by the slice is very cheap.

messages.text: Non preoccuparti, fa molto caldo oggi.
messages.english: Don't worry, it is very hot today.

choices.text: Meglio così! Non vedo l'ora di uscire.
choices.english: Better that way! I can't wait to go out.
choices.feedback: Positive and looking forward to it.

choices.text: Ho dimenticato le chiavi di casa sul tavolo.
choices.english: I forgot the house keys on the table.

choices.text: La banca centrale è dall'altra parte.
choices.english: The central bank is on the other side.

messages.text: Anch'io. Allora a più tardi, ciao!
messages.english: Me too. See you later then, bye!

choices.text: A dopo! Ci vediamo alle tre al parco.
choices.english: See you later! See you at three at the park.

choices.text: Non ho contanti, pago con la carta.
choices.english: I have no cash, I pay with card.

choices.text: Questo zaino è troppo grande per me.
choices.english: This backpack is too big for me.

conversations.title: Organizing a Dinner
conversations.description: Making plans with a friend to grab dinner together.

messages.text: Ciao! Sei libero questa sera per cena?
messages.english: Hi! Are you free this evening for dinner?

choices.text: Sì, sono libero. Ti va una pizza?
choices.english: Yes, I am free. Do you feel like a pizza?
choices.feedback: Answers the question and suggests a food option.

choices.text: Devo andare a comprare delle medicine.
choices.english: I have to go buy some medicine.
choices.feedback: This is a refusal, but the prompt implies agreeing.

choices.text: La mia camera è al piano di sopra.
choices.english: My room is on the upper floor.
choices.feedback: This is about a hotel room.

messages.text: La pizza è un'ottima idea! Dove andiamo?
messages.english: Pizza is a great idea! Where do we go?

choices.text: Conosco una pizzeria molto buona in centro.
choices.english: I know a very good pizzeria in the center.

choices.text: Mi piace andare in bici la domenica.
choices.english: I like riding a bike on Sundays.

choices.text: Il passaporto è nella borsa piccola.
choices.english: The passport is in the small bag.

messages.text: È la pizzeria vicino alla fontana grande?
messages.english: Is it the pizzeria near the big fountain?

choices.text: Sì, proprio quella. Fanno una pizza fantastica.
choices.english: Yes, exactly that one. They make a fantastic pizza.

choices.text: No, il treno non ferma a questa stazione.
choices.english: No, the train doesn't stop at this station.

choices.text: Ho letto un libro di storia antica oggi.
choices.english: I read an ancient history book today.

messages.text: Ottimo. A che ora ci vediamo allora?
messages.english: Great. What time do we meet then?

choices.text: Ci vediamo lì alle venti e mezza, ok?
choices.english: See you there at eight thirty pm, ok?

choices.text: Il volo è in ritardo di circa due ore.
choices.english: The flight is delayed by about two hours.
choices.feedback: This is about an airport flight.

choices.text: Voglio leggere un libro in biblioteca.
choices.english: I want to read a book in the library.
choices.feedback: This is about reading a book.

messages.text: Le venti e mezza è perfetto. Devo prenotare?
messages.english: Eight thirty is perfect. Should I book?

choices.text: Sì, per favore. È sempre molto piena di sera.
choices.english: Yes, please. It is always very full at night.

choices.text: Ieri ho comprato un vestito per la festa.
choices.english: Yesterday I bought a dress for the party.
choices.feedback: This is about a party outfit.

choices.text: Non riesco a trovare il caricabatterie.
choices.english: I cannot find the phone charger.

messages.text: Ho chiamato ma è tutto occupato a quell'ora.
messages.english: I called but it is all booked at that time.

choices.text: Ah peccato. E se andiamo alle ventuno?
choices.english: Ah too bad. What if we go at nine pm?

choices.text: La borsa gialla è sul tavolo di legno.
choices.english: The yellow bag is on the wooden table.

choices.text: Ieri ho mangiato una mela molto dolce.
choices.english: Yesterday I ate a very sweet apple.
choices.feedback: This is about eating an apple yesterday.

messages.text: Hanno posto alle ventuno, ho appena prenotato.
messages.english: They have room at nine pm, I just booked.

choices.text: Ottimo lavoro! Ti ringrazio per aver chiamato.
choices.english: Great job! I thank you for calling.

choices.text: La mia televisione è spenta e rotta.
choices.english: My television is off and broken.

choices.text: Oggi c'è la partita allo stadio nuovo.
choices.english: Today is the match at the new stadium.

messages.text: Ci vediamo direttamente dentro al ristorante?
messages.english: Do we meet directly inside the restaurant?

choices.text: Meglio vederci fuori, vicino all'ingresso.
choices.english: Better to meet outside, near the entrance.

choices.text: Preferisco viaggiare in treno di giorno.
choices.english: I prefer to travel by train by day.

choices.text: L'aereo per Milano parte fra tre ore.
choices.english: The plane to Milan leaves in three hours.

messages.text: Va bene. Speriamo di non dover aspettare.
messages.english: Alright. Let's hope we don't have to wait.

choices.text: Se abbiamo prenotato, non ci sarà problema.
choices.english: If we booked, there won't be a problem.

choices.text: Ho bisogno di una medicina per la gola.
choices.english: I need medicine for my throat.

choices.text: Il mio gatto ha graffiato la sedia.
choices.english: My cat scratched the chair.

messages.text: Hai ragione. A stasera alle ventuno!
messages.english: You are right. See you tonight at nine pm!

choices.text: Perfetto, non vedo l'ora. A stasera!
choices.english: Perfect, I can't wait. See you tonight!

choices.text: Ho un appuntamento dal dentista domani.
choices.english: I have a dentist appointment tomorrow.
choices.feedback: You are organizing dinner, not going to the dentist.

choices.text: La banca è aperta solo di mattina.
choices.english: The bank is open only in the morning.
choices.feedback: This is about a bank schedule.

conversations.title: Confirming Plans
conversations.description: Double-checking the details for a meetup that was already planned.

messages.text: Ciao! Ti scrivo per confermare l'incontro di oggi.
messages.english: Hi! I am writing to you to confirm today's meeting.

choices.text: Ciao! Sì, certo. È tutto confermato.
choices.english: Hi! Yes, of course. Everything is confirmed.
choices.feedback: Perfect way to confirm the meeting.

choices.text: Mi dispiace, ma non parlo francese bene.
choices.english: I am sorry, but I don't speak French well.

choices.text: Cerco un idraulico bravo per il bagno.
choices.english: I am looking for a good plumber for the bathroom.
choices.feedback: This is a home repair issue.

messages.text: Ricordami, ci vediamo alle diciotto o alle diciannove?
messages.english: Remind me, are we meeting at six pm or seven pm?

choices.text: Ci vediamo alle diciotto, come d'accordo.
choices.english: We are meeting at six pm, as agreed.

choices.text: Il museo chiude sempre alle venti in punto.
choices.english: The museum always closes exactly at eight pm.

choices.text: Oggi cucino io, preparo un pollo arrosto.
choices.english: Today I am cooking, I am preparing roast chicken.

messages.text: Giusto! Davanti al bar in piazza centrale, vero?
messages.english: Right! In front of the bar in the central square, right?

choices.text: Esatto, davanti all'ingresso del bar.
choices.english: Exactly, in front of the bar's entrance.

choices.text: La mia macchina è nel parcheggio blu.
choices.english: My car is in the blue parking lot.
choices.feedback: This is about a car park.

choices.text: Vorrei prenotare una bella camera singola.
choices.english: I would like to book a nice single room.

messages.text: Ci sono dei lavori per strada, forse farò ritardo.
messages.english: There are some roadworks, maybe I will be late.

choices.text: Tranquillo. Se fai tardi, aspettami dentro.
choices.english: Don't worry. If you are late, wait for me inside.

choices.text: Non trovo la fermata del treno veloce.
choices.english: I cannot find the fast train stop.

choices.text: Questo vino è molto buono, ne vorrei ancora.
choices.english: This wine is very good, I would like more.

messages.text: Ok, ti scrivo un messaggio quando arrivo in piazza.
messages.english: Ok, I will write you a message when I arrive in the square.

choices.text: Perfetto. Io cerco di essere puntuale.
choices.english: Perfect. I will try to be punctual.
choices.feedback: Agrees and promises to be on time.

choices.text: Non posso leggere senza gli occhiali nuovi.
choices.english: I cannot read without my new glasses.
choices.feedback: This is an issue about glasses.

choices.text: C'è una riunione di lavoro fra due ore.
choices.english: There is a business meeting in two hours.
choices.feedback: This is about a work meeting.

messages.text: Il bar potrebbe essere pieno a quell'ora, sai?
messages.english: The bar might be full at that time, you know?

choices.text: Nel caso, possiamo andare al parco lì vicino.
choices.english: In that case, we can go to the nearby park.

choices.text: Il mio orologio si è fermato questa mattina.
choices.english: My watch stopped this morning.
choices.feedback: This is about a broken watch.

choices.text: L'aereo è atterrato in ritardo ieri notte.
choices.english: The plane landed late last night.

messages.text: Buona idea, il parco è sempre molto tranquillo.
messages.english: Good idea, the park is always very quiet.

choices.text: Sì, e oggi il tempo è anche molto bello.
choices.english: Yes, and today the weather is also very nice.

choices.text: Vorrei cambiare questi pantaloni grigi.
choices.english: I would like to exchange these grey pants.

choices.text: Ho perso la valigia grande in aeroporto.
choices.english: I lost my large suitcase at the airport.

messages.text: Hai portato anche la tua bicicletta oggi?
messages.english: Did you also bring your bicycle today?

choices.text: No, sono a piedi. Tu hai la tua?
choices.english: No, I am on foot. Do you have yours?
choices.feedback: Answers and asks the same question.

choices.text: La porta del garage è chiusa a chiave.
choices.english: The garage door is locked with a key.

choices.text: Preferisco bere del succo di frutta fresco.
choices.english: I prefer drinking fresh fruit juice.

messages.text: Sì, ho la bici. La lascio legata al bar.
messages.english: Yes, I have the bike. I'll leave it chained at the bar.

choices.text: Ottimo, così possiamo camminare insieme.
choices.english: Great, so we can walk together.
choices.feedback: A nice comment on the plan.

choices.text: Mi fa male la spalla sinistra da ieri.
choices.english: My left shoulder hurts since yesterday.

choices.text: Questi stivali neri costano troppo per me.
choices.english: These black boots cost too much for me.

messages.text: A dopo! Non vedo l'ora di vederti.
messages.english: See you later! I can't wait to see you.

choices.text: Anche io! Ciao e fai attenzione per strada.
choices.english: Me too! Bye and be careful on the road.

choices.text: Il vento oggi è forte sulla spiaggia.
choices.english: The wind today is strong on the beach.

choices.text: Devo pagare una multa alta alla polizia.
choices.english: I have to pay a high fine to the police.
